preconditioning.notes: Estimated: Cadillac's DC fast-charging support page (cadillac.com returns 403; a search excerpt was seen earlier but the checker could not reproduce it) is said to describe automatic preconditioning when routing to a DC fast charger with built-in Google navigation, and a manual Fast Charge Prep in the app. UNVERIFIED: not read on a page for this model year; assumed for all LYRIQ years on the same Ultium software.

capacity_gross_kwh.notes: KBB lists battery capacity 102.00 kWh for all 2026 Lyriq trims (relaying Cadillac's 102 kWh). A bare capacity is treated as gross. Wikipedia and EVChargingStations say every LYRIQ and LYRIQ-V uses the same 102 kWh pack (2023-2027).

capacity_usable_kwh.notes: Estimated: Wikipedia: 102 kWh gross, 100 kWh usable; Auto-data gives net 100.4 kWh. Same 102 kWh pack across LYRIQ years and trims (years on this powertrain: 2023).

chemistry.notes: Estimated: EV Database lists the LYRIQ-V cells as GM Ultium 140Ah NMC pouch (GM calls them NCMA, closest enum nmc); same Ultium cells across all LYRIQ trims and years.

nominal_voltage_class.notes: Estimated: EVChargingStations (2027 page): 102 kWh pack shared by all LYRIQ versions, 400-volt class; same pack carried across years (2023).

dc_max_kw.notes: Estimated: Cadillac's stated max charge speed 190 kW (2026 model year per EVChargingStations; Wikipedia gives 190 kW for the model; Electrek repeats it for 2027). Same pack and charger hardware 2023-2027; no change found. Years on this powertrain: 2023.

ac_max_kw.notes: Estimated: 11.5 kW onboard charger is standard; a 19.2 kW charger is optional (about $1,480, higher trims, AWD per Cadillac's spec page); NRCan lists both Charger variants for the 2024-2026 Canadian LYRIQ, LYRIQ AWD and LYRIQ-V, captured per trim. Powertrain value is the standard charger. A Cadillac LYRIQ-V page was also read as listing 19.2 kW, which conflicts with a Cadillac-page excerpt saying the V uses 11.5 kW.

Estimated: NRCan 2023 "LYRIQ" and EPA 2023 LYRIQ list one 240 V charge time of 6.5 h, which matches the 19.2 kW car (2025 LYRIQ 19.2 kW: 7.0 h; 11.5 kW: 11.2 h; 2023 AWD, 10.7 h, is the 11.5 kW car). 100 kWh / 6.5 h is about 15 kW into the pack, not possible on 11.5 kW. Basis: same hardware in another model year, years compared 2023 and 2025. Replaces the repo 11.5 kW estimate. 2023 AWD stays 11.5 kW (10.7 h).
